{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Data shape:", df.shape)
print("Columns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("First few rows:\n", df.head())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("\nNumber of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("\nNumber of duplicate patient_id:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check sample_seq distribution
print("\nSample_seq max:", df['sample_seq'].max())

# Check assay_batch values
print("\nUnique assay_batch values:", df['assay_batch'].unique())"}
